_doc: check_empty_scope.py: which gates may report success over a repo with no content.
legitimate = it SHOULD pass on nothing, and the reason says why.
known_blind = a real defect awaiting a guard. SHRINK-ONLY: never add to this list;
a gate that gains a guard is deleted from it, and the sweep fails if a listed gate
starts failing (a stale excuse is permission nobody needs).

legitimate.check_disk_hygiene.py: it measures the HOST's scratch directories, not the repo, so an empty repo is irrelevant to it -- its subject is present whatever the tree looks like
legitimate.check_no_conflict_markers.py: a repo with no tracked files genuinely has no conflict markers, and there is no baseline to contradict: this gate has no population to lose

known_blind.check_no_allow.py: reported '0 files clean' -- it scans src/, benches/ and build.rs, so a Rust crate that moved its sources retires the gate in silence
known_blind.check_no_emoji.py: reported '1 tracked files clean' over a tree with one file; it should say what it expected to scan, or a repo whose sources stop being tracked passes clean
known_blind.check_no_secrets.py: same shape as check_no_emoji -- a tracked-file scan with no floor, so an untracked tree reads as a clean one
